fusions.name: Nibbled Seams
fusions.desc: A quick jab at the seams of the target's armour that deals 4 damage, leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and leaves it 5% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Hushing Scurry
fusions.desc: Scurries you up to 6 tiles to one enemy, dealing 10 damage and silencing it for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Scuttle Behind Steel
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 18% and your dodge chance by 10% for 10 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: After Lamps-Out
fusions.desc: At night, your armour rises by 12%. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.
